review.art: Existing canonical door pixels, exact 2x native export. Outer wall pixels extracted; identical frame in both states, transparent open aperture. No generated art or model.

backend.data: Generated records in isolated SQLite test database, destroyed afterward.

firefox: Open passage permits crossing while both jambs remain solid.
Occupied doorway rejects closing; clearing it permits closing.
Couch regression: both seats, all four directions, standing.
320px mobile width has no horizontal overflow; open action works.
Actual stage editor: imported isolated local stage, opened door, inspected native canvas.

typecheck.result: Project-wide typecheck reports diagnostics outside changed files. Changed files have no diagnostics.

review.limits: No authenticated live room/reconnect or cross-client multiplayer test. No actual player accounts, balances or placements changed.
